metadata.name: FAM-Bench Task 2: comparative dish analysis
metadata.gold_ranking_rule: Options are ordered by (1) no condition violation before a condition violation, (2) all available ingredients present before a missing ingredient, (3) higher nutrition-based health_score first. The answer is the top-ranked option.
metadata.images: options[].image_url is the photo used in the paper's image settings. 28 recipes have no public photo of the dish (image_url is null); see README.
